metadata.description: Free, local video production with Claude: Shorts, recording edits and faceless explainers.

plugins.name: video-studio
plugins.description: Make and edit videos with Claude using free local tools. One of three pieces released together: this plugin (skills, setup, registrations), the media-toolbox engine (Docker: transcription, TTS and cloned voices, SFX, FLUX images, ffmpeg) and the MangoAI editor (timeline, HyperFrames graphics, render), plus optional DaVinci Resolve (free) and Blender.
